title: Double check-valve assemblies.
officialText:
Double check-valve assemblies shall conform to ASSE 1015, CSA B64.5, CSA
B64.5.1, or AWWA C510. Double-detector check-valve assemblies shall conform to ASSE 1048. These devices shall be capable
of operating under continuous pressure conditions. These devices shall be tested annually by a New York State certified tester
employed by a New York City licensed plumber.
